purpose: Determine conceptual independence of the exact Campaign043 transaction-VWAP-consensus mechanism before implementing it or reading any protected value.

candidate.name: intraday_transaction_vwap_consensus_240m
candidate.formula: For each active continuous-session bar i, let p_i=amount_i/volume_i and w_i=volume_i/sum_j(volume_j). Return exp(sum_i(w_i*log(p_i))) / sum_i(w_i*p_i).

mechanism_family_review.reason: Prior mechanisms compare bar transaction prices with close, high-low envelopes, share-volume changes, close-return paths, or causal cumulative VWAP crossings. Campaign043 compares no bar with another field or time and uses no path order: it measures only the scale-free volume-weighted dispersion of positive active-bar transaction-price levels through the exact weighted geometric-to-arithmetic mean ratio.

Those factors use close increments, return energy, high-low interval geometry, temporal order, or fitted endpoint chords. Campaign043 reads no close/high/low, takes no difference or lag, and is invariant to permutation of the same active transaction-price/volume pairs. Statistical dependence on volatility remains explicitly challenged by all 64 frozen comparisons.

Campaign043 does not score the concentration, serial order, clock-time center, market synchronization, or opening share of amount or volume. Volume is used only as the economically exact weight for the dispersion of amount/volume price levels, and time-bin order is discarded.
Campaign043 reads no open, high, low, close, candle body, wick, interval, frontier, containment, overlap, range mass, or absorption event.
No cross-stock benchmark, disclosure, event, daily price, return target, lunch jump, or endpoint follow-through enters the formula.

Candidate49 uses close signs around a causal cumulative VWAP in future-only sessions. Campaign043 uses historical amount and volume only, ignores close and temporal crossings, reads no Candidate49 values or returns, and cannot enter Candidate49 signal or execution ledgers.
Campaign043 contains one raw weighted-mean inequality statistic and no prior factor value, learned weight, filter, threshold, transform search, fitted model, regime split, or combination.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.joint_zero_rule: volume=0 and amount=0 is inactive and excluded
design_choices_frozen_before_values.one_sided_zero_rule: exactly one of volume or amount is zero makes the stock-day missing
design_choices_frozen_before_values.negative_or_nonfinite_rule: any selected volume or amount that is negative or nonfinite makes the stock-day missing

decision.next_action: Validate all bindings, then freeze a fingerprint-bound no-return protocol with this exact candidate and the complete ordered 64-factor comparison library before implementation.
